data.notes: October 2026 in New York is anchored by Robtober and Mondo.NYC, with the most travel-worthy nightlife clustered around Brooklyn/Queens house, techno, diaspora, and queer dance-floor institutions.

events.title: Harry Styles: Together, Together. Harryween.
events.summary: Harry Styles’ 30-show Madison Square Garden run includes the October 31 Harryween performance, part of the Together, Together world tour.

events.title: Circoloco Halloween (Night 1)
events.summary: Circoloco's Halloween weekend opens at the Brooklyn Navy Yard with &ME, Mochakk, Seth Troxler, Rampa, Carlita, MAP.ACHE, Beltran, and Konstantin. Presented by Teksupport; sold out, resale only.

events.title: Circoloco Halloween (Night 2)
events.summary: Night two of Circoloco Halloween at Brooklyn Storehouse with Dixon, ANOTR, Jimi Jules, Aline Umber, Jamback, KROL, and Rossi. Presented by Teksupport; sold out, resale only.

events.title: Mondo.NYC Music Business Conference & Showcase Festival
events.summary: Mondo.NYC returns October 13–16 with panels, networking, and artist showcases based at Arlo Williamsburg and independent NYC venues. The 2026 edition lists 45+ panels, 200+ speakers, and 35+ artist showcases.

events.title: Carnegie Hall Opening Night Gala: Berliner Philharmoniker, Kirill Petrenko & Jonas Kaufmann
events.summary: The Berliner Philharmoniker’s Carnegie Hall appearance on October 8 features conductor Kirill Petrenko and tenor Jonas Kaufmann as part of the orchestra’s tour calendar.

events.title: Honey Dijon: Day & Night
events.summary: Honey Dijon leads a day-into-night Knockdown Center takeover with Luke Solomon, Anastazja, and Derrick Carter. The event is built around Chicago-rooted house and disco-driven club culture at one of Queens’ key large-scale dance venues.

events.title: Robert Glasper “Robtober” Residency
events.summary: Robert Glasper opens his acclaimed October Blue Note residency with an October 1–4 run. The residency blends jazz, R&B, and hip-hop collaborations in the intimate Greenwich Village club setting.

events.title: Music On: Marco Carola, Franky Rizardo, Mason Collective
events.summary: Marco Carola’s Music On lands at Pacha New York with Franky Rizardo and Mason Collective. The night centers on rolling tech-house and big-room underground grooves.

events.title: Mala Junta: Yazzus / Akua / FASHION / DJ TOOL / Kilopatrah Jones / Alfonso Javier
events.summary: Berlin collective Mala Junta takes over BASEMENT with Yazzus, Akua, and FASHION in the main room, plus DJ TOOL, Kilopatrah Jones, and Alfonso Javier in STUDIO. It is a high-profile techno and queer-underground booking for NYC’s warehouse circuit.

events.title: Animalia Nonstop: Fred P, Kia, Louis Marlo (live), Mia Koden, Moopie, Simisea
events.summary: Nowadays hosts an Animalia Nonstop marathon with Fred P, Kia, Louis Marlo live, Mia Koden, Moopie, and Simisea. The lineup connects deep house, techno, UK bass pressure, and psychedelic club music across an extended session.

events.title: Wata Igarashi all night long / ISAbella / Subb-an / Meilgaarden
events.summary: Wata Igarashi returned to BASEMENT for a special all-night hypnotic techno set, while STUDIO hosted ISAbella, Subb-an and Meilgaarden across queer rave, electro and rolling house strains.

events.title: Zenker Brothers / Pangaea / re:ni / The Carry Nation / Analog Soul / ALEXIS DE LA ROSA
events.summary: A heavy BASEMENT bill linking Ilian Tape, Hessle Audio and UK bass-techno currents with The Carry Nation and Analog Soul in STUDIO for a house-rooted counterpoint.

events.title: RA25: New York City
events.summary: Resident Advisor’s 25th-anniversary New York stop at Good Room featured Nick León, Galcher Lustwerk, adobeprincess, Stacey Hotwaxx Hale b2b Kilopatrah Jones, Special Guest DJ and Baalti.

events.title: City Of Gods Halloween Festival 2026
events.venueName: City of Gods Festival at Industry City
events.summary: City of Gods’ large-scale Halloween weekender returned to Industry City with House of Yes and ZERO involved, positioned around house, techno, deep house and immersive nightlife spectacle.

events.title: Black Coffee
events.summary: Black Coffee brings his globally influential Afro-house and deep-house sound to Pacha New York for a late-night Brooklyn club takeover.

events.title: beabadoobee: The Powerlines Tour
events.summary: beabadoobee brings The Powerlines Tour to Madison Square Garden. This is one of the month’s major arena-level pop/indie concerts in Manhattan.

events.title: Battle Hymn - Holiday Weekend
events.summary: Ladyfag’s Battle Hymn returns for a holiday-weekend Sunday session at Rumi with Kim Anh and resident Tedd Patterson. The party is one of NYC’s signature queer house-music gatherings.

events.title: FIST: Lacchesi / Nene H / Word of Command / DJ Clone / Jubilee / Mez Monty / Connor Wrong
events.summary: FIST takes over BASEMENT with Lacchesi, Nene H, Word of Command, and DJ Clone in the main room, plus Jubilee, Mez Monty, and Connor Wrong in STUDIO. The bill pushes heavy techno, electro, bass, grime, and house across the venue’s no-photo dance floors.

events.title: Book Club Radio Festival #2: The Outer Rim
events.summary: Book Club Radio’s no-phones warehouse festival took over Brooklyn Roots Collective and SILO with Tinzo, Jojo Lorenzo, Machinedrum, Mark Farina, Hiroko Yamamura, Byron the Aquarius, MikeQ, Nikki Nair, Soul Summit, Toribio and more.

events.title: DESCENDANTS with DJ TIRA, Danni Gato & More
events.summary: NY-born Afro-electronic platform DESCENDANTS hosted Durban gqom and house icon DJ TIRA with Danni Gato, Meedy, Pizzi and Val Fleury for a major Afro Tech night.

events.title: Dr. Rubinstein / The Advent / 98dots / Jay Jackson / Lauren Flax / Rumi de Baires
events.summary: BASEMENT hosted an acid-techno and rave-heavy lineup led by Dr. Rubinstein and The Advent, with STUDIO sets from Jay Jackson, Lauren Flax and Rumi de Baires.

events.title: MONSTA X: 2026 World Tour [THE X : NEXUS] in New York
events.summary: MONSTA X’s 2026 World Tour [THE X : NEXUS] is confirmed for Infosys Theater at MSG on October 6.

events.title: Nonstop: EscaFlowne, Honey Bun, Main Phase, Nicola Cruz, Peach, Rose Kourts
events.summary: Nowadays’ extended Nonstop format ran from night into afternoon with EscaFlowne, Main Phase, Honey Bun, Rose Kourts, Nicola Cruz and Peach across house, bass, garage and Latin-inflected club rhythms.

events.title: Mister Sunday Long Weekend Edition: Justin Carter and Eamon Harkin
events.summary: Mister Sunday’s long-weekend edition brings Justin Carter and Eamon Harkin back to Nowadays for an afternoon-into-evening dance. The party is a cornerstone of New York’s outdoor/early-evening house scene.

events.title: Gryffin
events.summary: Gryffin headlines Under the K Bridge Park in Brooklyn on October 17, with Łaszewo and AR/CO also listed.

events.title: Rawayana: ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour
events.summary: Rawayana brings the ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour to Barclays Center in Brooklyn on October 31.

events.title: Foster The People: Good Mourning Sunshine Tour
events.summary: Foster The People play Forest Hills Stadium on October 10 with Goth Babe listed on the bill.

events.title: Camilo
events.summary: Camilo is confirmed at Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden on October 17 at 9:00 PM.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti: Una Historia Importante
events.summary: Eros Ramazzotti’s Una Historia Importante tour stop is confirmed for October 24 at Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden.

events.title: Berlin Beyond Year 3
events.summary: ZERO, House of Yes, Garbicz Festival and Kater Berlin reunite for the third Berlin Beyond, a 12-hour Industry City house/techno gathering with lineup pending.

events.title: RUSH presents: KETTAMA
events.summary: Knockdown Center and RUSH bring KETTAMA to Queens for a late-night garage and tech-house session.

events.title: Cristian Castro: Nada Solo Éxitos Tour 2026
events.summary: Cristian Castro brings his Nada Solo Éxitos Tour 2026 to Infosys Theater at MSG on Friday, October 2.

events.title: ARODES & Guests
events.summary: Gray Area presents Arodes at 99 Scott for an extended Brooklyn appearance centered on melodic house and techno, with additional guests to be announced.

events.title: Sleepy Hollow Music Festival
events.summary: The third annual Sleepy Hollow Music Festival is confirmed for October 3 at Kingsland Point Park, with Everclear, The Smithereens with Marshall Crenshaw, Fastball, Sophie B. Hawkins and more announced.

events.title: The Nursery: Frank & Tony, Roman Flügel
events.summary: Public Records’ Nursery series continues with local deep-house touchstones Frank & Tony alongside German electronic mainstay Roman Flügel.

events.title: Geese: Getting Killed Again Tour
events.summary: Brooklyn band Geese headline Forest Hills Stadium on October 3 as part of the Getting Killed Again Tour.

events.title: The Nursery: Floorplan, CARISTA
events.summary: Public Records’ daytime Nursery series pairs Detroit-rooted house/techno force Floorplan with CARISTA for a Sunday dance-floor session.

events.title: KEIN KLUB
events.summary: Aionia’s recurring KEIN KLUB returns to H0L0 with Intergalactic Gary, Amelia Holt and TBA guests across two low-light rooms focused on raw, off-center techno and EBM.
